description: This file defines application configuration settings using a dataclass 'Settings'. It loads these settings from environment variables with default values, and exposes a function 'get_settings' to retrieve the configured settings object.

classes.name: Settings
classes.description: A frozen dataclass representing application configuration loaded from environment variables, including secret keys, token expiration, database URL, CORS origins, execution sandbox limits, and JWT algorithm.

methods.name: Settings get_settings()
methods.description: Function that retrieves application settings from environment variables, providing default values if not set, returning an instance of the Settings class.
